thread:
lina: hey team. opened PR with a short troubleshooting note for when streaming responses get cut off because the server returns a 429 mid-stream and we need to resume by trimming old context. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4890. want a tiny example in go rather than ts?
devon: nice. go could be useful for platform folks. keep it tiny: detect 429, wait, retry once, then trim oldest turns and call resume helper. mention cache invalidation header too.
noah: +1. also add a one-line warning: trimming can alter output; users should re-run a small eval set. maybe a short bullet under the snippet.
tess: question  do we show how to stitch the partial stream pieces or just call out to a helper? i'd prefer callout to a helper function so snippet stays <12 lines.
lina: ok i'll show a minimal Go pattern and reference a helper named TrimAndResumeStream in the caption. code below.
```go
// minimal Go example for docs: detect 429 mid-stream and fallback to trimmed resume
res, err := client.StreamGenerate(ctx, &GenerateOpts{Model: "rwd-medium-v1", Prompt: longPrompt})
if err != nil && api.IsRateLimit(err) {
  time.Sleep(250 * time.Millisecond) // brief backoff
  res2, err2 := client.StreamGenerate(ctx, &GenerateOpts{Model: "rwd-medium-v1", Prompt: longPrompt})
  if err2 != nil && api.IsRateLimit(err2) {
    trimmed := TrimOldTurns(longPrompt, 3) // preserve system + 2 recent turns
    // TrimAndResumeStream encapsulates: send trimmed prompt, receive stream, then stitch
    streamResp, _ := helpers.TrimAndResumeStream(ctx, client, trimmed, longPrompt.Metadata)
    if streamResp.Headers.Get("X-Prefix-Invalidate") == "1" {
      localPrefixCache.Clear(longPrompt.PrefixID)
    }
    return streamResp
  }
  return res2
}
return res
```
noah: good. use header name X-Prefix-Invalidate here to vary naming (we use both x-cache-invalidate and this in different places).
devon: add the one-liner about validation after the code: "Note: trimming can change outputs; validate against your eval prompt set."
tess: i'll review the PR and suggest a tiny caption describing the helper semantics (stitching caveats, cache invalidation, idempotency of resume).
pr-bot: docs PR #4890 updated by lina  change: add Go snippet + short guidance.
lina: thanks! adding @noah @tess as reviewers. plan to merge after any last comments and backport to /guides/troubleshooting if approved. :thumbsup:
